coordinate_system.axes: Original source GLB: X lateral, Y up, +Z forward. L is negative X; R is positive X.
coordinate_system.units: Meshy source units; original heights approximately 0.95; apply build normalization after reading these landmarks.
coordinate_system.center: [X,Z] anatomical torso center; intentionally differs from whole-mesh AABB center for tailed species.
coordinate_system.vertex_indices: Indices in source GLB POSITION accessor before any welding or Blender merging.

provenance.geometry: Read directly from immutable source GLBs; all source_sha256 values verified against source_manifest.json. Sources contain no skins or animations.
provenance.visual_review: Original textured Blender front/side views of all nine A-pose models.
provenance.joint_estimates: Joint X/Y, neck, ears and non-separated tail paths are visual anatomical estimates; Z values are local surface midpoint measurements, symmetrized with tail contamination excluded. Validate posed deformation before integration.
provenance.eyes: Eight detached eye pairs selected by measured geometry components after temporary 1e-6 positional welding. Bounds, centers, radii and original indices are measured. Otter eye ellipsoids are visual estimates on a fused face; constrain amplitudes.
